text:
sora: quick note from the veridian-v2 q4 smoke run: hit a small cluster of locale regressions in srt/ruby/bidi slices. en->ja BLEU ~-4.9 on srt-subset.

mei: ouch. can you drop the tiny repros?

sora: pasted two micro repros from the failing slice:

JA (vertical/subtitles) SRC: 『終了』
REF: "That's the end."
BASE FLOAT OUT: tokens [A,B,C] -> "That's the end."
Q4 OUT: tokens [A,C] -> "That's the end"  <-- missing middle token, sometimes stray fullwidth bracket appended.

AR (rtl bracket) SRC: "(هل ستأتي?)"
BASE pre-detok ids: [LP, WORDS..., RP]
Q4 pre-detok ids: [RP, WORDS..., LP]  <-- order reversed before detok

dmitri: looks like tokenizer/merge-table change. we switched to "q4-compact" generator that prunes rare subwords last week. can you run float weights with q4 merges to confirm?

sora: did that: float+q4-tokenizer reproduces both issues. enabling `--protect-punct` in tokenizer fixes the samples.

haruto: probable fix: enable punctuation protection for CJK/bidi ranges in the generator or revert the prune patch. quick hotfix: enable protect by default, regen compact tables, run targeted smoke.

eval-bot: nightly-multilang-run meta: run_id=2026-06-09_01 samples=10k flagged=127 top_flags=["ja-srt","zh-ruby","ar-bracket-bidi"]

sora: action items: 1) haruto to land hotfix on generator and regen (urgent), 2) add unit tests for vertical-srt/ruby/bidi to quant-onboard, 3) pause veridian-v2 canary on Dedicated until regen verified.

dmitri: ack, starting bisection on generator commits and adding the float+q4-tokenizer integration test.

sora: closing for now; please ping when regen complete so I can rerun the nightly slice. :rocket:
